name: A Player Mode
subtitle: AI chief of staff for your day
promotionalText: Your five-person executive team. The first 100 members get Executive Roundtable at $9.99/month, and it stays $9.99 while they stay subscribed.
description:
A Player Mode is your five-person executive team: an Executive Coach, an Executive Assistant, a Chief of Staff, an Accountability Partner and a Cognitive Behavioral Mindset Coach. It plans your day, remembers what you promised and keeps it moving, so your head holds less.

HOW IT WORKS
• Answer easy-tap questions: about 3 minutes to a working plan. No essays.
• It builds your Mind, Body, Spirit plan and Tracks: your goals, your rules and your minimum day. You approve each piece.
• Every morning your plan is ready: one priority, a short start, then the day. Bad days shrink automatically. No catch-up, no guilt.

WHAT IT TAKES OFF YOUR PLATE
• Your agenda, ready every morning and prioritised.
• The Radar catches dropped promises and flags who you owe a reply.
• Goal to plan to daily steps.
• Coaching one question at a time, with five modes: High-Pressure, Executive Review, Recovery, Sprint and Deep Work.

THREE PLANS, EACH DOES ALL 5 JOBS
• Executive Roundtable: it plans and coaches you; you do the last step.
• Executive Suite: it runs your whole life and acts when you tap yes.
• Autopilot: it handles recurring things on its own, inside rules you set. It saves money; it never spends it.
Buying a plan never grants autonomy: you switch on each permission yourself.

FOR
Founders and entrepreneurs, operators with side projects, parents, athletes and competitors, students, creatives, and anyone in a transition.

A Player Mode does not provide medical, psychological, legal, financial or therapeutic advice. Results are examples, not guarantees.
